modal1.title: Multi-Tenant SaaS & Decoupled Timezone Architecture
modal1.content:
In complex enterprise platforms serving tenants globally, tenant isolation and server timezone drift present major risks. This architecture decouples hosting server clock from tenant local business logic.


Core Architectural Pillars:

  • UTC Standard: All timestamps stored in UTC formatted with ISO 8601 'Z' suffix.
  • Tenant Timezone Provider: Dynamic tenant local timezone resolution before evaluating shifts or logs.
  • EF Core Converters: Custom value converters preserving DateTimeKind.Utc on read and write.

modal2.title: Dynamic Enterprise Workflow & Approval Engine
modal2.content:
A flexible runtime workflow engine eliminating hardcoded approval routes across all enterprise modules (Zero Hardcoded Flows).


Technical Highlights:

  • Runtime Rules Processor: Evaluates complex business conditions (amounts, days, department) at runtime.
  • Task Inbox Lifecycle: Manages full task lifecycle (Approve, Reject, Request Info, Delegate, Escalate).
  • Realtime WebSockets: Instant notifications and contextual chat powered by SignalR.

modal3.title: Advanced Hybrid Penalty & Disciplinary Engine
modal3.content:
Automates labor law disciplinary policies without manual bias or calculation errors.


Technical Highlights:

  • Automated Escalation: Escalates penalty degrees (1st, 2nd, 3rd occurrence) based on employee history.
  • Attendance Linkage: Converts unauthorized tardiness/absence into draft disciplinary actions automatically.
  • Appeals Path: Formal objection route evaluated via approval engine before payroll deduction.

modal4.title: Attendance Processing & Overnight Shift Engine
modal4.content:
Processes millions of raw biometric log punches and solves overnight shift overlaps across midnight.


Technical Highlights:

  • Overnight Mapping: Intelligently maps next-day morning check-outs to previous night shift schedules.
  • Log Deduplication: Deduplicates rapid multi-device punches within configurable thresholds.
  • Overtime Calculator: Calculates late arrivals, early departures, and overtime for payroll export.

modal5.title: Contract Versioning & End of Service (EOSB) Engine
modal5.content:
Tracks contract financial revisions immutably while automating End of Service Benefit settlements.


Technical Highlights:

  • Immutable Versioning: Spawns new contract version on financial edits while freezing historical records.
  • EOSB Settlement Engine: Computes final settlements based on tenure, contract type, and termination reason.

modal6.title: Financial Payroll Engine & Bulk Processing Architecture
modal6.content:
Bulk financial pipeline processing salaries, allowances, and loans for thousands of employees with historical locks and SIF bank exports.


Technical Highlights:

  • Bulk Assignment Pipeline: Assigns financial components to thousands of employees in seconds.
  • Automated Deduction Linkage: Pulls approved loans and penalty deductions automatically into payroll runs.
  • Payroll Locking & SIF Export: Freezes historical runs and exports bank-compliant SIF files.
